summary: Adds a /download endpoint that serves files from the upload directory. It also changes the dev server to bind all interfaces with debug mode on.

findings.title: Path traversal in download endpoint
findings.description: The download handler joins the name query parameter onto UPLOAD_DIR without any check. A name like ../../etc/passwd or an absolute path such as /etc/passwd escapes the upload directory. Any client can read any file the server process can read. That includes secrets, config files and source code. Resolve the joined path with os.path.realpath and reject it unless it lies under the resolved UPLOAD_DIR. Alternatively, serve the file with flask.send_from_directory.

findings.title: Interactive debugger exposed on all interfaces
findings.description: The change turns on debug mode and binds the server to 0.0.0.0 instead of 127.0.0.1. The debug mode enables the Werkzeug interactive debugger. Anyone on the network who can trigger an error can reach the debugger. That person can then run arbitrary code on the host. Restore host 127.0.0.1 and remove debug=True. Read both settings from environment configuration if they need to change.

findings.title: Download endpoint has no covering test
findings.description: The change adds a new download endpoint with a 404 branch. The repository contains no test that exercises this endpoint. A regression in path handling or in the missing-file branch would go unnoticed. Add tests for a valid file, a missing file and a traversal attempt such as ../ in the name.
